item.title: Open Call: BAX Artist In Residence, Brooklyn | Deadline April 2, 2026
item.description: Open call for NYC-based performance artists. BAX Artist in Residence offers an 18-month residency with space, stipend, and professional support. Apply by April 2, 2026.

item.title: Official Open Call: 2026 Franklin Furnace Jacki Apple Award, NYC
item.description: Open call for mid and advanced-career NYC-based performance artists. The 2026 Franklin Furnace Jacki Apple Award provides $10,000 for a project. Deadline May 1, 2026.

item.title: Open Call: ACC CREATORS Residency 2026, Art & Tech
item.description: ACC CREATORS Residency 2026 open call. Five-month art and technology residency, July–Nov 2026. Submission Feb 13–March 1.

item.title: Open Call: The Shed Open Call $15,000 Commission, NYC Deadline Feb 24
item.description: The Shed Open Call offers a $15,000 commission and production support for early-career NYC-based artists. Deadline February 24, 2026.

item.title: Open Call: Mabou Mines SUITE/Space Residency NYC
item.description: Mabou Mines SUITE/Space Residency offers two $4,000 stipends, rehearsal space, and performances for artists developing new work in New York City.

item.title: Open Call: Anonymous Was A Woman Environmental Art Grants (US)
item.description: Anonymous Was A Woman Environmental Art Grants of up to $20,000 for environmental art projects in the U.S. Open to women, transgender, and gender-nonconforming artists. Deadline April 7, 2026.

item.title: Artist Grant – Creative Capital Award $50,000 Project Grant | Contemporary Performance
item.description: The Creative Capital Award in an artist grant that offers a $50,000 grant and professional development support for artists in the United States. Deadline April 3, 2026.

item.title: Performance Residency – LIVE WORKS Free School Of Performance (€3,000 Fellowship)
item.description: LIVE WORKS Free School of Performance offers a €3,000 fellowship, performance residency, and project development support at Centrale Fies in Italy. Deadline April 3, 2026.

item.title: Artist Residency – Ninety Percent Of Everything (€4,000–€8,000 Funding)
item.description: Apply to Ninety Percent of Everything artist residency in Genoa, Italy. €4,000–€8,000 support for data-driven sound and visual practices. Deadline April 2, 2026.

item.title: Artist Grant – Franklin Furnace FUND - Performance Art, NYC
item.description: Franklin Furnace FUND offers $2,000 to $10,000 grants for early-career performance artists presenting new work in New York City. Deadline April 1, 2026.
